notes.title: Resette’s Prescription v1.1.1 Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
We've implemented the v1.1.1 update, which fixes the following bug:

Before fix: If you click while a line is in the middle of being displayed, it will clear what has already displayed and move on to displaying the next line.

After fix: If you click while a line is in the middle of being displayed, it will display the full line and not advance until you click again.

notes.title: Resette's Prescription Atelier Book Now Complete~
notes.content:

Thank you again for everyone who supported this project!

notes.title: English Artbook Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. First of all, thank you to everyone who supported this project. Resette's world is a lovingly crafted one and we can't wait to share this setting information with you. We've included some screenshots for the English artbook, and we're hoping to release it to everyone who's purchased it soon!

With your support, hopefully we can all see more of Resette's world together!
